Team,

I'm ready to move forward with an offer for Priya Sharma (Req 5421, Sr Backend Engineer). Summary of the compensation package I'm proposing:

- Role: Sr Backend Engineer (L4)
- Base salary: $195,000
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.16% RSU 4yr vest (1yr cliff)
- Target start: 2025-10-20 (flexible 2 weeks)

Comp band for L4 (attached comp-band-L4-2025.xlsx) lists midpoint at $190k, range 170k–210k. This offer is slightly above midpoint; I believe the mix of base + sign-on keeps total comp within band guidance.

Checklist / asks for recruiting/ops:
- Monica/Tessa: please create the formal offer in Greenhouse and select the standard Redwood offer template (Draft attached: 2025-09-10-draft-offer-priya-sharma.pdf).
- Route approvals in this order: Hiring Manager (me) -> Finance (Markus) -> People Ops (Laura) -> Legal (if Legal review is flagged) -> CEO Office only if comp band override > 15% above midpoint.
- Please attach the comp rationale doc when you kick off the approvals (template link below).
- Enable DocuSign e-sign and set offer expiration to 7 calendar days.

Related links: https://app.greenhouse.io/jobs/5421/offers and comp rationale template: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/hr/comp-rationale-template

Timeline: my ask is to have the routed approval by end-of-day Friday 9/12 so we can send to Priya early next week.

Let me know if any of you foresee issues; if so, call me and we can triage quickly.

Thanks,
